title: Architect’s Assistant
description: adds commands to make life easier
body:
### Architect’s Assistant
Architect’s Assistant is a tool for builders, just to make life easier.
It may be a boring mod because it was just for me but i am making a modpack for builders, so i think it became useful to publish it

## New commands
This mods adds commands especially for vanilla commands that are very long, like the give, effect, gamerule commmands.

# give commands
- /command to get a command block
- /light to get a light block
- /barrier to get a barrier block
- /axe to get a wooden axe
- /wool [color](between the [] you wan to put the color of wool you want) to get a wool block of the color of your choice

# gaemrule commands
- /daycycle [true/false] to change the do day light cycle gamrule

# effects commands
- /night_vision to get a night vision effect for almost 14000 hours with no particle

thats all the mod does, if you have any suggestion, please do tell me
